newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FORECAST-Benpres 1996 net seen up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Benpres 1996 net seen up 25 pct.

text.p: Benpres Holdings Corp is seen posting 2.02 billion pesos net profits in 1996 in line with company projections of a 25 percent rise from 1.616 billion pesos in 1995, according to a Reuters poll.

The poll of eight brokerage houses completed this week showed that in 1997, Benpres, the holding company of the Lopez family, is likely to generate 2.54 billion pesos in profits, a 25.7 increase from the estimated 1996 earnings.
The company has said it expects to sustain 25 percent earnings growth in the medium-term. It is likely to announce to announce its 1996 earnings later this month or in February.

Analysts said the company's holdings in a major bank, PCIBank, the country's largest power utility, Meralco, and its broadcasting and cable television units, including the ABS-CBN television channel, will all contribute to revenues.
This year, the company's telecommunications and property development business may start to contribute to revenues, they added.

"Benpres' earnings are due to the good performance of its subsidiaries ABS-CBN, Meralco and PCIBank. I think for 1997, we would see contributions from Rockwell Land," said Ivy Cayayan, an analyst at Philippine Asia Equity.
